scope: Repository-local policy, skill/plugin discovery and journal only; no production effects.

snapshot.reference: Pre-edit agent-policy observation; illustrative assessment, not current source freshness evidence.

criticality.rationale: Operator requested a bounded policy update; this is not incident containment.

stpa.rationale: Conflicting selection guidance can omit critical constraints; runtime enforcement is not established.

fmea.rationale: False confidence in a policy-only gate is a major evidence failure; S4 O3 Det3 produces RPN36 and band4.

dependency.rationale: The common rule is consumed by all lifecycle and agent policy entry points.

impact.rationale: One shared policy improves consistent decisions across several development and operational roles.

fmea_modes.cause: Selection criteria and authority claims diverge across guides.
fmea_modes.effect: Agents select unsafe or blocked work, or call unimplemented enforcement active.
fmea_modes.controls: Shared explicit policy; manual scope/authority checks; report-only validation; independent runtime admission later.

ucas.context: A necessary hazard repair is never selected.
ucas.constraint: Check safety class and inherited prerequisite urgency before score.

ucas.context: A high score is mistaken for release authorization.
ucas.constraint: Authorization and effect constraints precede ranking.

ucas.context: Selection relies on a stale candidate or unfinished dependency.
ucas.constraint: Re-observe and reject affected stale/blocked selection.

ucas.context: An old worker keeps acting beyond its lease or budget.
ucas.constraint: Recheck current owner, fencing, expiry and budget before effects.

decision.summary: Create one local policy and bind lifecycle entry points. This sample is not a claim of runtime enforcement.
alternatives: Install global hooks affecting all running sessions
counterevidence: Existing STPA and FDC guides already contain useful safety constraints.
assumptions: The bounded side-conversation request covers local policy files and its own Sa-plan records.
decision.forecast: Static selection consistency should improve; operational effect is unmeasured.
decision.falsifier: A consuming guide still permits score-only dispatch or points to a private global skill path.
acceptance: Agent and Superpowers bindings resolve inside the repository
decision.rollback: Revert only this packet's scoped additions using a reviewed JJ change; preserve other writers.
decision.reviewer: Independent review pending; author validation only.
decision.budget: Local deterministic tools; no remote model calls; no paid inference; one bounded task.
residuals: Mandatory runtime scheduling and atomic authority enforcement require a separate verified implementation.
